selection_rationale: autocand_01 (Scale-sensitivity of Generate–Verify–Repair) best matches the CNSM Agentic-AI track: it tests an operationally meaningful NetOps reliability question with clear, falsifiable hypotheses, a paired design for strong internal validity, and feasible resource needs (~2000 model calls). The major criticisms are addressable before preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: Deterministic verifier coverage for semantic/regression checks may be incomplete.
Topology-synthesis procedure and heterogeneity parameters may not represent production diversity.
Prompt/template sensitivity and exact LLM selection could drive outcomes.
Per-bin sample-size/power requirements are unspecified (risk of underpowered interaction tests).
API rate limits and cost could constrain planned iterations or retries.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Provide a formal verifier specification (syntax + semantic + reachability + policy oracles) with a test-suite and documented failure modes.
Define the topology-generation procedure with parameters for size and vendor heterogeneity; publish example seeds/topologies for reproducibility.
Specify exact hosted LLM model identifiers, temperatures, prompt templates, and freeze them in the preregistration.
Add an explicit sample-size/power calculation for the primary outcome and preregister per-bin N and random seeds.
Define a conservative retry policy and a logging/schema: record raw outputs, verifier traces, iteration counts, and hashes for full reproducibility.
